data.body: CROSS-EPIC COORDINATION from cf65-e3b4-0bea-4756: 4911-c7ba child story cf65-e3b4-0bea-4756 adds a detected_by classification field to bug tickets. 69e8's Graduation Phase should consume detected_by tags as a graduation-candidate weighting signal — production-caught (detected_by:production) and review-caught bugs are higher-value graduation candidates than test-caught bugs (which already demonstrate working tests). The field allows /dso:retro to filter graduation candidates by channel via ticket list --has-tag=detected_by:<channel>.
